label: late original-phase u in sequences starting with d/q
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.005% of steps). About 82% of activation mass sits on input token u during the original phase, almost all at positions 5-7, which in practice means 1-2 tokens before <DEL>. It is strongly conditioned on sequence history: first token d (19x lift, 69% of mass) or q (5.6x), and an earlier a/b/j/v in the prefix (often a right before u). The top activations are of the form d q j v b a u. A small leftover (6% of mass) fires at the <DEL> step of similar d-initial sequences, and some weak activations land on other tokens in d/q-initial sequences. It never fires in the copy phase or at positions 0-3. Most u tokens at late positions do not fire, even with d/q first (precision about 0.2), so the conjunction of history tokens that sets the magnitude is only partly captured. Larger activations go with d first plus several a/b/j/v tokens earlier in the prefix.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=d (+5.04), orig0=q (+3.16), orig1=q (+2.39), prev_tok=a (+2.25), orig3=b (+2.18), orig2=v (+2.16). Lower it: phase=2 (-2.72), prev3_tok=- (-2.68), t=4 (-1.70), t=3 (-1.69).
